hooks.name: block_damage_abort
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's BlockDamageAbortEvent)

rust_summary: A server player stopped digging before the block broke (`native_block_damage_abort`).
doc_summary: A server player stopped digging `pos` before the block broke: `native_block_damage_abort(player, name, pos)` is heard after the server clears the dig and sends the block state back to the client. The player's state is not swapped in. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_damage_abort@.
